call_points.text: Non-MF margin fell to 13% in Q1 from 17%-plus; guided to 16-17% for FY27.
Overall cost increase targeted below 10% for FY27 and the next two to three years.
Alternatives AUM crossed ₹3.2 lakh crore with 50 new mandates won in Q1.
Cash balance about ₹980 Cr at quarter end; board declared ₹2.5 interim dividend.
Management expects residual MF yield compression of 2.5-3% annually, with the telescopic part already in the base.
Cloud, data-centre and hardware costs are rising faster than expected and will partly offset AI savings.
Account aggregator, pension and CAMS Repository are not yet EBITDA positive; CAMSRep expected to turn positive on a final-quarter basis.
Overall cost growth guided below 9% in FY27, with employee cost growth below 5%.
Data lake on Google Cloud is ready and will go live in 1H FY27.
